d: We are seeking an experienced AI Trainer to design and deliver high-quality training programs in Artificial Intelligence. The ideal candidate is passionate about teaching, possesses strong technical expertise in AI, and can translate complex concepts into practical, hands-on learning experiences. The trainer will prepare learners for real-world AI careers through project-based instruction and technical mentorship.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
Experience delivering technical training, workshops, bootcamps, or mentoring.
Strong proficiency in Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or LangChain.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to learners with different levels of experience.
Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus, or FAISS.
Experience with MLOps concepts and model deployment.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
r: Deliver instructor-led training in Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.
Teach both foundational and advanced AI concepts through practical, project-based learning.
Guide trainees in building production-ready AI applications.
Evaluate learner performance and provide constructive technical feedback.
Support learners throughout their training journey and encourage continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices.

d: The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) provides operational HR support to a large engineering workforce, ensuring the effective implementation of HR processes, employee services and company policies. Acting as the main HR contact for managers and employees, the HRBP supports employee development, workforce administration, employee relations and compliance with company procedures.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
4-8 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in an engineering, industrial or multinational environment.
Good knowledge of HR operations, employee relations and UAE employment legislation.
Strong organisational, communication and coordination skills.
Proactive, hands-on and capable of working independently.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and HR information systems.
Be currently based in Abu Dhabi or elsewhere within the UAE.
Have experience working within a multicultural and international environment.
Have experience as HRBP in Engineering companies.
Demonstrate the maturity and confidence to manage day-to-day HR matters independently.
Be comfortable operating as the primary HR contact for a significant employee population.
Show initiative and ownership in identifying issues and driving solutions.
Understand the importance of alignment, governance and teamwork, recognising when to escalate matters and seek guidance.
r: Support and advise managers and employees on day-to-day HR matters, company policies and HR procedures.
Coordinate Learning & Development activities, including training plans, logistics, attendance management and training records.
Monitor and follow up on the performance appraisal process and Performance Development Plans (PDPs) to ensure timely and effective implementation.
Ensure the effective application, compliance, monitoring and control of company policies and procedures.
Manage employee onboarding, integration and offboarding processes.
Administer and coordinate employee lifecycle changes, including promotions, salary reviews, temporary assignments, transfers and other employment-related changes.
Monitor workforce requirements and coordinate with Talent Acquisition team to ensure timely recruitment and resource availability.
Handle employee relations and disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable legislation.
Oversee and make sure that employee records, personnel files and HR documentation are accurate.
Prepare HR reports, workforce metrics and related documentation.
Organise employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities and corporate events.
Coordinate with Personnel Administration, General Services, Health & Safety, Payroll and Immigration functions on matters affecting employees and the Engineering Centre workforce.
Support the implementation of HR initiatives, organisational development projects and continuous improvement activities as required.
Support workforce planning, employee engagement and organisational initiatives as required.

As well as Implement various HR processes and policies by providing day-to-day HR support and solutions to attract, manage, develop, motivate and retain employees to achieve business objectives in line with business needs, overarching HR plans/ policies, best practices and current legislation/regulations.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior management, providing insights on HR best practices, workforce planning, and organizational development.

Regular capture and assess the Voice of Employees through meetings, focus groups, Employee Opinion Surveys (EOS) with the specific goal of identifying any perceived areas requiring improvement and developing and implementing solutions, which foster positive employee relations and thereby enhance productivity.
